regionalDeductions.label: Deducción por arrendamiento de vivienda habitual
regionalDeductions.help: 20% capped at 800 EUR generally, rising for tenants under 35 or with a disability. v1 applies the general rate only. Subject to regional income limits and a deposited fianza.

inputSchema.label: I qualify for the Valencian rent deduction
inputSchema.help: Habitual residence, within the regional income limits, fianza deposited with the Generalitat.

inputSchema.label: Rent paid during the year
inputSchema.help: The deduction is 20% of this, capped at 800 EUR at the general rate.

omissions: The enhanced rent rates for under-35 and disabled tenants, and the Valencian birth, childcare and sport deductions, are not modelled in v1.
